 1. The Annunciation

PROMPT:
Blessed Virgin Mary: young Jewish woman, age 15-18, oval face, soft olive complexion, large expressive brown eyes, delicate nose, gentle features, long dark-brown hair mostly covered by a cream veil, deep blue mantle over muted red robe, serene and humble expression, identical facial features in every image. Jesus Christ: Jewish male, age appropriate to the mystery, shoulder-length dark-brown wavy hair, neatly trimmed beard, olive complexion, warm brown eyes, noble and compassionate features, identical facial structure throughout the series, white tunic and muted red robe during public ministry. Saint Joseph: middle-aged Jewish man, sturdy build, short dark-brown hair with slight gray at the temples, trimmed beard, kind brown eyes, tan robe with dark-brown cloak, identical appearance throughout the series. Archangel Gabriel: youthful angelic male, radiant face, long light-brown hair, luminous white robes with gold embroidery, large white feathered wings, warm heavenly glow. Art Style: traditional Catholic sacred art, High Renaissance masterpiece, inspired by Raphael, Murillo, and Bouguereau, museum-quality religious painting, realistic anatomy, detailed faces, rich natural colors, dramatic reverent lighting, subtle gold highlights, historically accurate biblical clothing and architecture, sacred atmosphere, no modern elements, masterpiece quality, highly detailed, 3:4 portrait orientation. The Annunciation. The Archangel Gabriel appears before the Blessed Virgin Mary inside a modest Nazareth home. Mary kneels beside a wooden prayer stool, surprised yet serene, as golden rays of divine light descend from heaven. White lilies symbolize purity. Gabriel gestures reverently while delivering God's message. Sacred stillness, deep spiritual emotion, warm golden illumination, humble stone walls, historically accurate first-century Judea. Traditional Catholic sacred art, High Renaissance masterpiece, museum-quality religious painting, ultra-detailed, 3:4 portrait orientation.

Negative Prompt: cartoon, anime, comic style, CGI, 3D render, text, watermark, signature, modern clothing, modern objects, blurry details, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, duplicate persons, oversaturated colors, fantasy armor, science fiction elements.

The Opening of the Holy Rosary. A majestic crucifix stands at the centre of a quiet, candlelit chapel, the figure of Christ serene in death, with soft divine light falling upon Him from above. Draped over the foot of the cross and flowing down onto a carved wooden prie-dieu in the foreground is a complete rosary of deep red beads with a gold crucifix, medal, the short chain of five beads and the full circle of beads clearly visible. Above the cross, in a golden opening in the clouds, the Holy Trinity is suggested: God the Father in radiant glory and the Holy Spirit as a white dove in a burst of light. Rich natural colours, dramatic reverent lighting, subtle gold highlights, deep stillness and prayer. Traditional Catholic sacred art, High Renaissance masterpiece, museum-quality religious painting, ultra-detailed, 3:4 portrait orientation.

The Hail, Holy Queen. The Blessed Virgin Mary is enthroned as Queen of Heaven and Mother of Mercy, crowned with a golden crown and twelve stars, her deep blue mantle spread wide by angels to shelter a kneeling gathering of the faithful beneath it: pilgrims, mothers with children, the elderly, the poor, all with hands joined in prayer and faces turned towards her. Mary looks down on them with gentle compassion and holds a rosary in her right hand. Golden clouds and cherubim surround the throne; warm heavenly light pours down on the people below. Rich blue, gold and crimson, tender maternal love, sacred grandeur. Traditional Catholic sacred art, High Renaissance masterpiece, museum-quality religious painting, ultra-detailed, 3:4 portrait orientation.
